product_one_liner.value: Ethos uses AI to match professionals’ expertise with paid consulting, advisory calls, research and other opportunities, while helping organizations source expert insight.
product_one_liner.notes: Ethos’s homepage at https://askethos.com/ describes matching people’s expertise to opportunities; the Ethos product description at https://agent.askethos.com/opportunities/ai-engineer describes matching human expertise to paid advisory, consulting and full-time opportunities.

pricing_page.notes: Ethos Evals has a public pricing page at https://evals.askethos.com/pricing, which describes its pricing as “Simple pricing. No subscription.”

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Ethos Recruiting’s page at https://www.recruiting.askethos.com/ labels the section “COMPANIES HIRING WITH ETHOS” and names Elm Labs and Kendal.ai. | named_customers.0: The recruiting page at https://www.recruiting.askethos.com/ identifies Elm Labs in the “Companies hiring with Ethos” section. | named_customers.1: The recruiting page at https://www.recruiting.askethos.com/ identifies Kendal.ai in the “Companies hiring with Ethos” section.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile at https://linkedin.com/company/askethos reports 670 employees; the Tracxn record at https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/65ad398116fed41697f2650f/ethos reports 671. Both exceed the largest permitted band (201–500), so no listed band fits.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Tracxn company record at https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/65ad398116fed41697f2650f/ethos reports the location as London, United Kingdom. | hq_country: The Tracxn company record for Ethos at https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/65ad398116fed41697f2650f/ethos reports its location as London, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The Tracxn company record identifies Ethos at https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/65ad398116fed41697f2650f/ethos and reports founded_year: 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The updates index at https://askethos.com/updates shows product-oriented posts such as “Company Profiles” and “Introducing Investment Researcher”; the reviewed posts are product announcements, not engineering or technical how-it-is-built articles. The blog index at https://askethos.com/blog likewise did not show engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The main homepage footer at https://askethos.com/ lists Home, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and Expert Terms but no docs/help link. Ethos Evals has a public MCP guide at https://evals.askethos.com/mcp, but the reviewed page is a single guide rather than a docs/help portal with several articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Ethos AI Engineer opportunity at https://agent.askethos.com/opportunities/ai-engineer is explicitly marked closed and says it is no longer accepting applications; no live AI/ML staff opening was identified.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini, Groq, Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter
model_provider.notes: Ethos’s subprocessor list at https://agent.askethos.com/ethos-subprocessors names Google for Gemini and AI language processing, Groq for AI inference, Anthropic and OpenAI for AI language processing, and OpenRouter for model gateway and routing services.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Ethos’s DPA at https://agent.askethos.com/ethos-dpa explicitly says its terms ensure compliance with UK GDPR and, where applicable, EU GDPR. GDPR is the named item; the DPA only mentions SOC 2 and ISO 27001 as examples of reports or certifications, not as certifications Ethos claims to hold. | compliance_certs.0: The Ethos DPA at https://agent.askethos.com/ethos-dpa names UK GDPR and EU GDPR as compliance obligations.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The TechCrunch announcement at https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/06/ethos-raises-22-75m-from-a16z-for-its-expert-network-with-voice-onboarding identifies the latest round as Series A. | funding_date: The TechCrunch funding announcement at https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/06/ethos-raises-22-75m-from-a16z-for-its-expert-network-with-voice-onboarding is dated May 6, 2026, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-05. | funding_amount_usd: The May 6, 2026 TechCrunch announcement at https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/06/ethos-raises-22-75m-from-a16z-for-its-expert-network-with-voice-onboarding reports a $22.75 million Series A.

raised_18mo.notes: The May 6, 2026 Series A announcement at https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/06/ethos-raises-22-75m-from-a16z-for-its-expert-network-with-voice-onboarding falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Senior Account Executive posting at https://agent.askethos.com/opportunities/senior-account-executive is a paid opportunity to train a client AI lab’s model, not an Ethos staff vacancy. The General Catalyst Ethos job board at https://jobs.generalcatalyst.com/companies/ethos-2-e1b0048b-7d7c-4a76-97d7-b71911ec294a shows an “Open jobs at Ethos” section but no staff titles or postings.

launched_6mo.notes: Ethos’s LinkedIn company post at https://linkedin.com/company/askethos is dated 2026-11-06 and announces opening a private beta of its Evals platform, within the six-month window before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: the reviewed company pages did not provide a complete, verifiable Ethos leadership roster or a dated C-level/VP join-or-departure event for the 12 months before 2026-11-09.
